name: 白盒角色占位流程
description: 快速生成角色占位资源，用于对话和交互测试。生成 Billboard 配置，运行时由 BillboardFactory 渲染。
author: Pipeline-Sys

character_id.description: 角色 ID (如 cenhui, gulin, songlan)

color.description: 角色标识色 (十六进制颜色)

nodes.name: 参数接收
nodes.expression: ({ character_id: inputs.character_id, character_name: inputs.character_name, character_type: inputs.character_type, color: inputs.color, icon: inputs.icon, created_at: new Date().toISOString() })

nodes.name: 加载角色档案
nodes.description: 尝试加载角色档案获取更多信息

nodes.name: 生成 Billboard 配置
nodes.description: 创建/更新角色的 Billboard 配置
nodes.content:
# 角色配置 - ${inputs.character_id}
# 由 whitebox-character 流程自动生成
# 创建时间: ${new Date().toISOString()}

character_id: "${inputs.character_id}"
character_name: "${inputs.character_name}"
character_type: "${inputs.character_type}"

# 白盒配置
whitebox:
  enabled: true
  billboard:
    type: "character"
    icon: "${inputs.icon}"
    color: "${inputs.color}"
    name: "${inputs.character_name}"
    style: "${inputs.character_type}"
  portrait:
    type: "placeholder"
    color: "${inputs.color}"

# 资源元数据
meta:
  asset_mode: "whitebox"
  created_by: "whitebox-character-flow"
  production_ready: false
  expressions: []

nodes.name: 更新角色注册表
nodes.description: 将角色添加到全局注册表

nodes.name: Git 提交
nodes.command: git add src/data/characters/${inputs.character_id}.yaml src/data/character-registry.json && git commit -m "whitebox: 添加/更新角色占位 ${inputs.character_id}" || echo 'No changes'

nodes.name: 成功通知
nodes.description: 发送白盒角色创建成功通知
nodes.message: 白盒角色创建成功: ${inputs.character_id} (${inputs.character_name}) - 类型: ${inputs.character_type}

nodes.name: 警告通知
nodes.message: 白盒角色 ${inputs.character_id} 创建完成但有警告，请检查日志
